title: DELUXE TRIM PANEL & INSERT
summary: Deluxe interior door trim panel (RPO 403 & 424 custom interior) with its pull handle, lower molding and carpet insert. This sheet was CANCELED 2-13-70. As drawn, the panel is screwed to the door at its front edge, the pull handle is screwed on at its rear end, a screw goes through the escutcheon by the inside handle, the lower molding pushes into holes along the panel's bottom, and the carpet insert is glued to the lower panel. Panel, handle and carpet numbers come from charts.
